title: oxygen.json
description: Install configuration for @oxygenui-design/cli: where components land in this project, and which registries it may reach.

root.description: Directory this project's "@/" import alias resolves to. Every registry target is written beneath it.

registries.description: Namespaced registries, keyed by a name beginning with '@'.

headers.description: Sent with every request. Write credentials as ${ENV_VAR}; the CLI refuses a literal token, because this file is meant to be committed.
